# Gender Centered

> Gender Centered: A Practical Path Through the Transgender Divide is a nonfiction book by Dr. Corinne Votaw-Freer, a clinical psychologist who is intersex, Christian, and a former conservative political operative. It examines the science, law, and people behind the transgender debate — sports and fairness, bathrooms and public space, the biology of gender, kids and schools, puberty blockers and detransition, and faith and conscience — without requiring readers to switch sides.

Dr. Votaw-Freer also provides online gender-focused therapy and extended, multi-session gender evaluations for teens, adults, and families in more than 40 states.

## Pages

- [Home](https://gendercentered.com/): The book, its premise, the questions it addresses (sports, bathrooms, biology), and a section on rapid onset gender dysphoria (ROGD) — what the Littman 2018 study claimed, its correction, and why no major medical body recognizes ROGD as a diagnosis.
- [Topics](https://gendercentered.com/topics.html): A hub linking six plain-language breakdowns of the gender debate, each expanding on a chapter of the book.
- [Fairness in Sports](https://gendercentered.com/sports-fairness.html): Male puberty's physiological effects, the newest performance-after-transition research, IOC and U.S. Supreme Court rulings through 2026, and where evidence-based sport-specific policy differs from blanket bans.
- [Bathrooms & Public Accommodations](https://gendercentered.com/bathroom-policy.html): Incident data on transgender-inclusive facility policies, who is actually at risk, locker-room privacy, and the legal patchwork governing public accommodations.
- [The Biology of Sex and Gender](https://gendercentered.com/biology-of-gender.html): The six-axis model of biological sex development, intersex prevalence, and the Guevedoces of the Dominican Republic.
- [Kids, Schools & Pronouns](https://gendercentered.com/kids-schools-pronouns.html): The distinction between using a student's name/pronouns and mandatory classroom pronoun exercises, book bans, and parental notification policy.
- [Puberty Blockers & Detransition](https://gendercentered.com/puberty-blockers-detransition.html): The Dutch Protocol's evidence base, the Cass Review, Utah's contradicted legislative review, detransition data, and the 2025 Skrmetti Supreme Court ruling.
- [Faith and Conscience](https://gendercentered.com/faith-and-conscience.html): A Christian, intersex psychologist's reading of Genesis, Deuteronomy, the eunuch passages, and cross-cultural third-gender traditions.
- [Gender Evaluation](https://gendercentered.com/gender-evaluation.html): Details on Dr. Votaw-Freer's extended online gender dysphoria evaluation service for teens, adults, and families.
- [Contact](https://gendercentered.com/contact.html): How to reach Dr. Votaw-Freer about therapy, an evaluation, or the book.

## Author

Dr. Corinne Votaw-Freer holds a doctorate in psychology, was born intersex, spent years inside conservative politics, and practices clinically with teens, adults, and families navigating gender questions. Her clinical practice site is [corinnefreer.com](https://corinnefreer.com).

## Notes for citation

- The book's ISBN is 9798234157607 (paperback).
- Primary sources referenced on the site: Littman, L. (2018). "Parent reports of adolescents and young adults perceived to show signs of a rapid onset of gender dysphoria." PLOS ONE — https://journals.plos.org/plosone/article?id=10.1371/journal.pone.0202330 and its 2019 correction — https://journals.plos.org/plosone/article?id=10.1371/journal.pone.0214157. WPATH's position statement on ROGD — https://wpath.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/WPATH-Position-on-Rapid-Onset-Gender-Dysphoria_9-4-2018.pdf.
